results.name: the progression and flag proofs are identical in two vm contexts and the plain context (four, seed 42)
the engine exposes checks {progression, flags, refs, reach, landable} and stays frozen

16 worlds (demo and four, 8 seeds each, 64 chapter walks, 1016592 cells) prove clean: every site reached and entered, every lock shut then opened by its seal, every later chapter sealed, no flag problem, not even a warning
the proofs take 21 ms (walk) and 22 ms (flags) per world in the plain context
every chapter of the four fixture reports its held keys, vehicles, sites, lock, and sealed state
before the ship no sea cell is reached; with it the party sails (32217 sea cells) and steps ashore on another continent
the airship (chapter 5) reaches every one of 15922 landable cells and never lands on a shut gate; without it less is reached
even with the airship every later chapter site front is reached but none can be entered, so the chapter stays sealed
with the airship disabled (airshipAt 0) no chapter holds it and the walk is still clean
an open pass is caught: later ground walked to early (early-ground)
a keyless landing or seawall on a later continent is caught (early-ground: the ship reaches its inland early)
a boss lock that does not need the seal is caught (lock-open)
a boss lock no key in the game opens is caught (lock-shut)
a later golden key that opens early is an error naming the chapter it leaks into (early-key)

detail.message: The golden key in dgn|chp_the_marches_m4r2|key (chapter chp_the_marches_m4r2) can be reached and entered during chapter chp_the_lowlands_auem.
